caption: The drawing features two views of a small building model with yellow walls, a dark grayish-blue roof, and four large red chimneys, each topped with brown decorative elements. The building has multiple windows with gridded panes and is set on a green base with a light brown border. The left side of the drawing shows the front and side perspective of the model, including a covered front porch supported by two thin posts and decorative edging around the roof and porch. The word "BANK" appears above the front entrance, which consists of double doors with small windows. The right side of the drawing shows the back and side view of the same building without the porch, revealing an open door and a circular window opening. Both perspectives show the building’s fantasy or toy-like architectural style.
title: Toy Bank Building
